summary.key_theme: 市場高度關注 Alphabet 即將公布的第 3 季財報，特別是 Google Cloud 的營收成長與 AI 資本支出之間的平衡。

bullish.title: Sundar Pichai Reported Alphabet's Cloud Revenue Grew 82% Last Quarter While the Gemini App Reached 950 Million Monthly Users
bullish.reason: 雲端業務營收成長 82 % 且 Gemini 用戶數達 9.5 億，顯示 AI 變現能力強勁，為股價提供強力支撐。

bullish.title: GOOGL's $250B AI Chip Opportunity Takes Aim At NVDA
bullish.reason: 分析師指出 Google 透過自研晶片挑戰 NVIDIA 的硬體經濟模式，具備長期獲利潛力。

bullish.title: Constellation Energy Pledges 890 MW of Uprates for Google: “Growing Energy Needs”
bullish.reason: 與 Constellation Energy 簽署 3,590 MW 的核能電力協議，確保 AI 資料中心長期能源供應穩定。

bullish.title: Alphabet (GOOGL): Investing Behind AI Demand and TPU Growth
bullish.reason: Broyhill Asset Management 看好其在 AI 需求與 TPU 成長上的投資策略。

bullish.title: Google's next TV gadget may do much more than stream
bullish.reason: 硬體升級將 Gemini 整合至家庭娛樂設備，有助於擴大 AI 生態系應用場景。

bullish.title: What Investors Overlooked Before Intel's 127% Run
bullish.reason: 提及 Google 與 Intel 的合作關係，顯示其在硬體供應鏈布局的廣度。

bearish.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Cloud Outage And Share Token Fight Put Regulation In Focus
bearish.reason: 倫敦雲端服務中斷事件引發監管機構關注，可能增加營運風險與合規成本。

bearish.title: Google’s Ex-CEO Says China Trails US by 6 Months in AI Race, but Could Still Win Due to This Strategy: ‘We’re Already Losing’
bearish.reason: 前執行長 Eric Schmidt 對 AI 競爭局勢的擔憂，暗示地緣政治風險可能影響長期競爭力。

bearish.title: The $500 Billion Question: Can Google Cloud’s Massive AI Backlog Outrun Its Mind-Boggling CapEx Boom on Oct. 28?
bearish.reason: 市場擔憂龐大的資本支出（CapEx）是否能被雲端 AI 營收成長有效抵銷，存在獲利壓力。

neutral.title: Dow Jones Futures: Microsoft, Google, Amazon Lead Earnings Wave; What To Do In Mixed Market
neutral.reason: 彙整多篇關於財報週市場預期的報導，屬於市場情緒觀察，無具體公司利多或利空消息。

neutral.title: Peter Schiff Says Google Gemini Challenged Government’s Case Against His Bank: ‘Did Nothing Wrong’
neutral.reason: 涉及外部銀行訴訟案，雖提及 Gemini，但對 Alphabet 本身財務影響有限。

neutral.title: Eric Schmidt Rejects AI Bubble Fears, Says Anthropic Is Growing Twice as Fast as Google Did
neutral.reason: 評論 AI 產業發展，對 Google 競爭對手 Anthropic 的成長描述屬中性產業分析。

neutral.title: Countdown to Alphabet (GOOGL) Q3 Earnings: Wall Street Forecasts for Key Metrics
neutral.reason: 單純整理華爾街分析師的財報預測數據，不具備方向性影響。

neutral.title: Marissa Mayer studied AI in the ’90s before joining Google
neutral.reason: 關於前高層的歷史回顧，對目前股價無實質影響。

neutral.title: Bro went from a 700-person village in Slovakia to Google then built an app that makes $2k/day
neutral.reason: 個人創業故事，與 Alphabet 公司營運無直接關聯。
